% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): samples that are inf or nan,
% discarded (initial) or interrupting the line, and restrict y to domain.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ymin=-6, ymax=6]
\addplot[domain=-3:3, samples=13] {1/x};
\addplot[domain=-3:3, samples=13, red, unbounded coords=jump] {1/x + 2};
\addplot[domain=-2:4, samples=25, blue] {ln(x)};
\addplot[domain=-3:3, samples=31, green!50!black, restrict y to domain=-4:4] {x^3};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
